text:
Zara - CS: Fernway final preflight this AM. Need last confirmations for peering, IAM, HSM-backed KMS, and SIEM ingestion before we greenlight cutover.
Ben - NetEng: Peering done for us-east-1 -> us-west-2, but they asked for explicit route propagation. Waiting on their cloudops to accept the TGW attachment. Pinged fops@fernway.io.
Hannah - Security: HSM note: customer insists on using their CloudHSM cluster for key material. We need a cross-account grant and to confirm our service principal can call Encrypt/Decrypt. Also they require audit chain hashing with SHA-256.
Luis - Platform: App needs a DNS entry in their private zone so callbacks resolve. If they use split-horizon DNS, confirm the internal CNAME. Also tracing endpoint must be reachable on 9411.
Zara - CS: Renewal signal is warm. This cutover is a consolidation milestone — if we miss the window, renewal health drops to yellow. I'll flag AM if any of the three items (TGW acceptance, role ARN, HSM ARN) are missing by 18:00 PT.
Ben - NetEng: Requested exact worker CIDR (they proposed 10.250.8.0/28) and EIP for NAT if using static egress. They replied with CIDR tentatively but no EIP yet.
Hannah - Security: Shared grant example and asked for their HSM key ARN. Example: `Grant: GranteePrincipal=arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/Fernway-CrossAcc, Operations=[Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey]`
Luis - Platform: SIEM ingestion: they will pull CloudTrail from an S3 bucket; need bucket ARN + object ACL policy. Also asked whether we sign logs with a detached sig (they said yes).
infra-bot: Deployment window scheduled: fernway-private-cutover - 2033-11-09T20:00Z -> 2033-11-10T00:00Z
Ben - NetEng: If they plan DirectConnect, also need ASN + LOA. Asked for it in the same thread.
Hannah - Security: Rotation: they want manual rotation every 90 days with rotation events logged to their SIEM. Need their SOC contact to approve.
Luis - Platform: Platform checklist: (1) DNS internal CNAME (2) allowlist EIP/egress range (3) runbook smoke test — I'll draft three checks. ETA 13:30 PT.
Zara - CS: Action items summary: Ben -> confirm CIDR + NAT EIP + TGW acceptance; Hannah -> get HSM key ARN + SOC approval for rotation + grant template; Luis -> smoke test + DNS + SIEM ingestion test.
Ben - NetEng: I will call their network lead at 14:00 PT if EIP not confirmed.
Hannah - Security: Asked for SOC contact: secops@fernway.io. Also requested their preferred nonce scheme for log signing (they picked detached sig with timestamp).
Luis - Platform: Drafted smoke test and will attach runbook: steps = [api-ping, callback-ack, trace-check].
Zara - CS: Can we add a short feedback form post-cutover (4 quick checkboxes + free comment)? Want to capture infra friction and any gaps in runbook.
Ben - NetEng: +1. Also asked them to confirm whether they require our team to assume the cross-account role during cutover. Different auditing on their side.
Hannah - Security: Received HSM key ARN `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555666777888:key/abcd-ef01-2345`. Preparing explicit grant and will post template.
Luis - Platform: Noted. If EIP is ephemeral, we'll enable extended retries for callbacks for the first 90 minutes and log increased backoff.
Zara - CS: Great. If TGW acceptance and role ARN are in place by 18:00 PT, we'll mark cutover as green. Otherwise escalate to customer exec. I'll post runbook link when Luis uploads. :white_check_mark:
